Hepatitis D and E (HDV; HEV) HDV is uncommon in
the United States and requires HBV to replicate. In order to
be infected with HDV, someone must already be infected with 
HBV. Transmission of the virus occurs via contact with infected
blood. Hepatitis E usually causes an acute infection and does
